Category:Vitamins.scope: Vitamins — 13 essential vitamin categories for humans, including eight B vitamins; chemical vitamers within a category are not separate vitamins in this convention.

Category:Countries.scope: Sovereign states — 195 under the UN convention: 193 member states and two non-member observer states, the Holy See and Palestine. Recognition disputes change broader counts; “nation,” ethnic group, and state are not interchangeable. Applies to State territory and Geopolitical Area.

Category:Lakes.scope: Lakes — about 117 million with area at least 0.002 km², the GLOWABO satellite inventory (2014), excluding Greenland and Antarctica. A size-threshold estimate relevant to Standing-water area; lakes are not necessarily freshwater.

Category:Humans.scope: Humans — about 8.3 billion living individuals in 2026, a rounded global population estimate, not a count of everyone who has ever lived.

Category:World population.scope: Humans — about 8.3 billion living individuals in 2026, a rounded global population estimate, not a count of everyone who has ever lived.

Category:Languages.scope: Human languages — 7,170 living languages, Ethnologue's 29th edition (2026), as reported by Wikipedia. Language-versus-dialect boundaries depend on the catalogue; extinct and constructed languages are outside this total.

Category:Algorithms.scope: Algorithm, Computable function, and Recursive function — each countably infinite under the usual finite-description convention. Finite formal expressions, finite symbol strings, and finite graphs of arbitrary size are also countable; this follows by finite-string encoding, not from a survey of existing examples.
